title: Invertible sheaves trivialize over inverse images of neighborhoods under finite morphisms
statement: Let $p:Y\to Z$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let $M$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. For every point $z\in Z$ there exists an open neighborhood $V\subseteq Z$ of $z$ such that $M|_{p^{-1}V}\cong\mathcal O_Y|_{p^{-1}V}$ as sheaves of $\mathcal O_Y|_{p^{-1}V}$-modules.
